subject.title: feat(ui): add visual overview feature hero

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new visual hero at the top of the Control UI Overview page once the i18n and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The patch adds a new first-screen product/design surface based on private Discord context, and code review cannot infer that the layout and copy are the intended Overview direction.

options.title: Require visible sponsor before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open, ask for the product/design rationale to be summarized publicly, and revisit after i18n plus screenshot proof are added.

options.title: Accept after mechanical fixes
options.body: Treat the Discord request as enough direction and merge once the i18n blocker and real browser proof are addressed.

options.title: Decline the hero direction
options.body: Close or ask for a smaller polish PR if maintainers want the Overview page to remain card-first.

recommendation.title: Require visible sponsor before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, ask for the product/design rationale to be summarized publicly, and revisit after i18n plus screenshot proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the recent Overview-area PR and appears in adjacent Control UI/i18n history.
